headline: Caesars Entertainment (CZR) Earnings Put Its Undervalued Narrative Back In Focus
summary: Caesars Entertainment earnings and buyback update Caesars Entertainment (CZR) just reported second quarter 2026 results, alongside an update on its share repurchase program, giving investors fresh data on revenue, losses and capital returns. The company reported second quarter sales of US$2,254 million and total revenue of US$2,993 million. headline: Caesars Entertainment (CZR) Stock Looks Cheap Even After The Take Private Deal
summary: Caesars Entertainment stock is coming off a difficult five year stretch, with the share price down about 67%, yet recent valuation work suggests the market may now be pricing it too low. At the current US$29.75 share price, both the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and the market multiples point to a company that screens as undervalued rather than expensive.
